witness_subject.artifact_state_label: Boundary 2 development candidate reviewed against World d9b78164228764faa2e731ced1264cd5a8082741
witness_subject.schema_or_environment: BPI2 profile 1 / PST2; source-backed feasible trace independently checked against the exact candidate
witness_subject.input_state_or_trace: A valid resource lists introducer function ids [0,2], with root function 2. Root-first canonical traversal maps them to [1,0].

record.observed_fact: canonical.resource uses order-preserving ids for introducers after a non-monotone function renaming. resource_admission then requires strict increasing order, so canonicalization rejects the valid source with NonCanonical.
record.independence_basis: Introduction authority under a root-induced function permutation; repeated reviewer reports are the same semantic witness.

witness_subject.schema_or_environment: BPI2 profile 1 / PST2; source-backed feasible trace independently checked against the exact candidate
witness_subject.input_state_or_trace: Two valid unit-returning functions share a resource eliminator authority set [0,1]. Function 1 is the root and packs/unpacks the resource. Canonical traversal renames this set to [1,0].

record.observed_fact: The eliminators field is remapped by position without restoring its set order. The resulting program violates the same strict-order requirement and fails final admission with NonCanonical.
record.independence_basis: Elimination permission is a distinct authority field and permitted operation from resource introduction; it has its own remapping path.

record.law_ref: Public all-result choice supports valid values borrowing from an enclosing live region without allowing borrowed-region escape.

source_refs.summary: [P2] Preserve borrowed regions on the choice return function

witness_subject.artifact_state_label: Boundary 2 development candidate reviewed against World d9b78164228764faa2e731ced1264cd5a8082741
witness_subject.schema_or_environment: BPI2 profile 1 / PST2; source-backed feasible trace independently checked against the exact candidate
witness_subject.input_state_or_trace: Inside an outer live region, call library.choice.allScoped with a cell-containing element and its descriptor in borrowed_regions. Consume the resulting sequence inside that region and return a first-order root result.

record.observed_fact: choice.interpret passes borrowed_regions to its operation clause but declares the generated element-to-sequence return function with an empty region row. Region admission rejects its cell-dependent parameter and result despite the enclosing owner remaining live.
record.independence_basis: Library-generated return-clause region context, independent of catalog renaming and capture-scope admission.

record.law_ref: Source bind preserves definite authored failure and the terminal custody of owned inputs along its represented execution paths.

source_refs.summary: [P2] Propagate definite failure through the left side of bind

witness_subject.artifact_state_label: Boundary 2 development candidate reviewed against World d9b78164228764faa2e731ced1264cd5a8082741
witness_subject.schema_or_environment: BPI2 profile 1 / PST2; source-backed feasible trace independently checked against the exact candidate
witness_subject.input_state_or_trace: An authored helper receives an owned resource and has body bind(x, fail(error), pure(unit)); x is unused and the helper can never return normally.

record.observed_fact: Source check assigns the bind the right term result even when its left result is null for definite failure. Lowering therefore treats the function as normally returning and drops the unused owned parameter from its entry environment; target admission rejects the generated edge for lost ownership. Direct fail retains that custody.
record.independence_basis: Failure on the left operand of sequential composition, with an owned function input; the existing normal-return discard negative is the required countercase.

record.law_ref: Capabilities select live explicit handler attachments and cannot escape the lifetime of the installation that supplies them.

source_refs.summary: [P1] Reject capabilities escaping their handler installation

witness_subject.artifact_state_label: Boundary 2 development candidate reviewed against World d9b78164228764faa2e731ced1264cd5a8082741
witness_subject.schema_or_environment: BPI2 profile 1 / PST2; source-backed feasible trace independently checked against the exact candidate
witness_subject.input_state_or_trace: A handler body returns its freshly supplied capability through an identity return clause to an internal caller. That caller performs with the returned capability after the handler has returned; the ultimate root result remains first-order unit.

record.observed_fact: Program admission checks the effect family and handler answer type but gives the returned fresh capability no installation-lifetime restriction. World removes the selected delimiter before entering the return clause; a later perform cannot find its attachment in the active parent chain and returns InvalidScope. Root first-order checks do not exclude this internal trace.
record.independence_basis: Fresh attachment lifetime across handler return. Older outer capabilities and delimiter-owning packages are valid countercases, so family membership cannot be inferred from capability schema alone.

[P1] Validate owned-region bounds before admitting captures

witness_subject.artifact_state_label: Boundary 2 development candidate reviewed against World d9b78164228764faa2e731ced1264cd5a8082741
witness_subject.schema_or_environment: BPI2 profile 1 / PST2; source-backed feasible trace independently checked against the exact candidate
witness_subject.input_state_or_trace: A deep outer handler encloses with_region. Its body performs the handled operation while the resumption type has owned_regions=[]; no region-valued continuation slot is needed. The runtime captures the region_scope frame before the selected outer delimiter.

record.observed_fact: with_region admission checks nominal parameters and effects but does not require escaping captures to own the allocated region frame. World always allocates that frame, while state_admission.capture requires every captured region_scope descriptor in signature.owned_regions. The admitted trace can therefore produce a state rejected with InvalidOwnership.
record.independence_basis: Ownership of a dynamically captured region scope even when slot-schema capture analysis has no region or cell witness. The final review also reports the same omitted frame bound on source-state-local.
